reserveReview.rationale: Classification-only research on 2026-10-09 retains the 2026-10-03 composition date and unmeasured 100% strategy envelope. The XGLD-specific Accountable response reports gross venue totals for Binance and Bnb_smartchain, without a token/position inventory or borrowed-USDT liability schedule. Neither venue label identifies an economic reserve class, exhaustive issuer/obligor census, contractual maturity maximum or reserve realization horizon. The primary XGLD page describes XAUt collateral, BYBIT borrowing and delta-neutral strategies; its seven-day holder cooldown does not establish liquidity of either reserve location. Published platform terms and the address index concern USDu/sUSDu and do not identify XGLD's immediate legal custodian. No live percentage, debt-netted NAV, financial-assurance credit or tracked-parent allocation is inferred.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer strategy and gross Accountable venue disclosure; borrowed debt not netted
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Both live Accountable location slices, Binance and Bnb_smartchain, lack exact economic-instrument inventories, complete obligor identities, contractual maturities and reserve realization terms in the XGLD-specific primary surfaces reviewed 2026-10-09. Gross location values cannot establish those facts. Borrowed liabilities, immediate legal custodians, segregation and net weights remain unestablished; the original compositionAsOf is retained.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: At the 2026-10-03 dashboard observation Binance represents about 95.1% of gross venue reserves, with the remainder on BNB; this is concentration evidence, not a legal-custodian or net-backing share. Program OES docs name Copper/Ceffu, segregated MPC cold storage and approximately hourly rebalancing in USDu context, but do not bind those providers or protections to XGLD. Exact Fund Vault addresses, XGLD legal custody/continuity, borrowed liabilities and net weights remain unverified.
